newsitem.title: USA: ATHLETICS-SPRINT QUEEN JONES TO RUN IN EUROPE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-SPRINT QUEEN JONES TO RUN IN EUROPE.

text.p: New U.S. sprint queen Marion Jones will put her blazing speed on display in Europe for the first time Tuesday, her coach said Monday.

Jones, who ran the year's three fastest women's 100-meter times and captured the women's long jump at the recent U.S. championships, will open her European campaign with a 100 meters at Turin, Italy, on Tuesday, according to coach Trevor Graham.
She will also run 100 meters at Lille, France, on Sunday, at Lausanne on July 2, and at Olso on July 4. She is scheduled to run 200 meters at Stockholm on July 7.
"We didn't get to do a lot after the U.S. championships, so she is not in great shape," Graham said in an interview. "But we think she is good enough shape to do well in Europe."

Jones still plans to compete in both the 100 meters and long jump at Athens world championships in August, Graham said. "But she won't be jumping in Europe on this trip," he added. "We just didn't have time to work on her jumping that much, but we're going to get it right."
